plugins.name: paste-peek
plugins.description: See the images you paste into the prompt, in real pixels, right above it: switch with ⌥←/⌥→, zoom with ⌥↑, side pane with ⌥↓. macOS, foreground Ghostty or kitty.

plugins.name: agent-monitor
plugins.description: Subagent monitor: a live band above the prompt, and /sub with this session's subagent history, alerts (file conflicts, stalls, tier mismatches, denied calls), per-agent detail and a cost estimate.

plugins.name: pr-hint
plugins.description: Shows the current branch's PR on the prompt hint row (title and its state: Draft, Ready or Merged); hover the hint row to preview a card of the spec, integration branch, CI and every ticket's progress, click the ▸ before the PR number to keep it open.
